title: Count the Skaters
setup: May 10, 1979, Game 7 of the Prince of Wales Conference final at the Montreal Forum. Boston leads the Canadiens 4-3 with 2:34 left. Linesman John D'Amico notices the Bruins have too many skaters on the ice and tells referee Bob Myers, who had been watching the play, not the Bruins' bench.
question: What does Myers do?
options: Waves it off, since the extra skater was not involved in the play.
Calls a bench minor for too many men on the ice.
ruling: Myers called the penalty. Peter McNab served the bench minor. Guy Lafleur tied the game 4-4 with 1:14 left in the third period, and Yvon Lambert won it for Montreal 5-4 at 9:33 of overtime.
rulebookNote: The source cites Rule 18, too many men on the ice.
